headline: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 jumps from 20.24% to 54.43% matched code
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 rises from 20.24% to 54.43% matched code, with 3,186 of 5,109 entries reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The largest batch adds 140 functions, dominated by large hero routines repeated across levels (#29). Drek's Fleet becomes the first level whose own code is fully matched (#32).
highlights: A tool-assisted transfer brings 100 US implementations to PAL, followed by additional reviewed library and long-function work (#26).
New quadword copy and zeroing helpers unblock more implementations (#31).
#32's finished-entry increase includes 29 new matches, 22 linker remnants and four joined pieces. It is not 55 newly reconstructed functions.
Another small-to-medium function batch opens as #30 and has not merged.
